content: Purushartha shunya nam gunanam pratiprasavah kaivalyam svarupa pratishtha va chiti shaktir iti. (Kaivalya is the eternal resting of Consciousness in its own sovereign radiance).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Purushartha shunya nam gunanam pratiprasavah kaivalyam svaru...) focuses directly on purushartha and shunya. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on purushartha today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper purushartha and shunya in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
